printPages.civicBlock:
CIVICTWIN Semarang — Civic Intelligence Proof of Concept
2026
React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet, React Router | Competition Proof of Concept (Demo Data)
Developed a civic intelligence proof of concept for Semarang linking district-priority mapping, citizen feedback, simulated OPD follow-up, and policy-scenario exploration.
Implemented a browser-based demo using localStorage, mock reports, prototype district markers, and rule-based CivicSense guidance.
Awarded 3rd Place at the UNITY UNY 2026 Smart City Competition.
printPages.pilBlock:
Purwokerto Intelligence Layer — Smart City Decision-Support Prototype
2026
React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet, React Router | Experimental Material (Simulated Data)
Developed an interactive Smart City decision-support prototype covering Purwokerto's four subdistricts to model civic indicators and spatial urban analytics using simulated urban indicator datasets.
Implemented a Multi-Criteria Decision Making (MCDM) weighted formula enabling dynamic policy weighting across public service, economic, and infrastructure indicators.
Engineered geospatial GIS visualization with Leaflet and GeoJSON subdistrict boundaries, citizen feedback logging, and policy brief drafting modules.

printPages.civicBlock:
CIVICTWIN Semarang — Bukti Konsep Civic Intelligence
2026
React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet, React Router | Bukti Konsep Kompetisi (Data Demo)
Mengembangkan bukti konsep civic intelligence untuk Semarang yang menghubungkan peta prioritas kecamatan, masukan warga, simulasi tindak lanjut OPD, dan eksplorasi skenario kebijakan.
Mengimplementasikan demo berbasis peramban menggunakan localStorage, laporan simulasi, penanda kecamatan prototipe, dan panduan CivicSense berbasis aturan.
Meraih Juara 3 dalam UNITY UNY 2026 Smart City Competition.
printPages.pilBlock:
Purwokerto Intelligence Layer — Prototipe Pendukung Keputusan Smart City
2026
React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Leaflet, React Router | Bahan Eksperimen (Data Simulasi)
Mengembangkan prototipe interaktif pendukung keputusan Smart City untuk empat kecamatan di Purwokerto guna memodelkan indikator publik dan analisis spasial perkotaan menggunakan data indikator simulasi.
Mengimplementasikan rumus berbobot Multi-Criteria Decision Making (MCDM) untuk menyesuaikan bobot kebijakan secara dinamis pada indikator layanan publik, ekonomi, dan infrastruktur.
Mengembangkan visualisasi GIS dengan Leaflet dan batas kecamatan GeoJSON, pencatatan masukan warga, serta modul penyusunan ringkasan kebijakan.
